content_sections.heading: RITES AM/ PAPIS Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES AM/ PAPIS Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: RITES AM/ PAPIS Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES AM/PAPIS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application for RITES AM/PAPIS Recruitment 2026 is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the AM/PAPIS post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-time B.E./B.Tech. or Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunication/Information Technology (IT) or an equivalent Engineering Degree/Diploma to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the AM/PAPIS position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 140,000 per month, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RITES AM/PAPIS recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official RITES website or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What are the important dates for the application process?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 6 August 2026 and ends on 26 August 2026. Tentative dates for admit card issuance and interview are also provided.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AM/PAPIS post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Scrutiny/Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the RITES office located?
faq.answer: The RITES office is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with a pincode of 122001.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES).
